video_title: 🚨 EMERGENCY POD 🚨 How did the Celtics let this happen? Jaylen Brown traded to the 76ers

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown traded to 76ers for Paul George and picks
quotes.excerpt: Jaylen Brown gets traded to the 76ers for Paul George, two first-round picks, and two second-round picks.
quotes.quote: Jaylen Brown gets traded to the 76ers for Paul George, two first-round picks, one of which is convoluted which I am going to hope Bobby is going to explain to us in a second, and two second-round picks.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Trade speculation suggests Celtics made the move under duress
quotes.excerpt: What people are saying to me, Bobby, and this is just the league speculation, is that this was a trade that was made under duress.
quotes.quote: What people are saying to me, Bobby, and this is just the league speculation, is that this was a trade that was made under duress. This was not a trade that you would make in a clinical setting. There is no deadline, it didn't have to do it by the end of July 4th, that you wouldn't do this trade under these circumstances if everything was equal, if something wasn't equal.

quotes.speaker: Bobby Marks
quotes.summary_phrase: Celtics needed to regroup after failing to land a better package
quotes.excerpt: Sometimes you just got to put your phone down and walk out of the room.

text_blocks.speaker: Bobby Marks
text_blocks.text: As my 20-year-old told me on Saturday afternoon, Jaylen Brown had a conversation about analytics, Dad, sometimes you just got to put your phone down and walk out of the room. And why I say that is if you're the Celtics, sometimes you just got to walk away from the table and regroup and figure it out down the road eventually. And it's easy for me to say because there's probably some funky locker room dynamics here, but this was not the trade package I thought was going to be in place when you look at Jaylen Brown.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim MacMahon
text_blocks.text: Bobby, you made that reference to put the phone away and let's just say what it was. You were trying to explain why Jaylen Brown's value isn't what you would think for a guy who's coming off of finishing sixth in the MVP and a second-team All-NBA selection and a couple years removed from a Finals MVP.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Front offices believe Jaylen Brown is significantly overpaid
quotes.excerpt: The analytic-driven front offices believe that Jaylen Brown is significantly overpaid and they don't value him nearly as much as the media does.
quotes.quote: The simple fact is the analytic-driven front offices believe that Jaylen Brown is significantly overpaid and they don't value him nearly as much as the media does. To be straight up, the media is the one that votes on all those awards. And so, Windhorst, as you're talking to this GM, I promise you one thing he didn't say is we had a better offer on the table.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Celtics traded Jaylen Brown and failed to land Giannis Antetokounmpo
quotes.excerpt: I believe what happened was they decided we're trading Jaylen Brown and then they tried to get Giannis and they got caught without contingency plans.
quotes.quote: I believe what happened was they decided we're trading Jaylen Brown and then they tried to get Giannis and they got caught without contingency plans. And the one thing I'll be honest about here, I don't understand why they took this offer now. Training camp doesn't start next week. This seems to me to be an offer you'd take in late August or September because you feel like, well crap, we got to take the best thing on the table.

quotes.speaker: Bobby Marks
quotes.summary_phrase: Celtics trade for Paul George includes protected first-round pick
quotes.excerpt: So it's a 2031 protected first, 2028 first-round pick that can convert from a first to a swap that is more favorable to Boston.
quotes.quote: So it's a 2031 protected first, 2028 first-round pick that can convert from a first to a swap that is more favorable to Boston. So in 28, they've got that Clipper pick. Their own pick goes to Brooklyn as part of the Harden trade. Brooklyn, that maybe Phoenix, eventually it's Brooklyn has it and then it can convert and it's protected 1-8. So I'm thinking it's got to be the Clipper pick there.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Celtics trade strategy aims to maximize pick value
quotes.excerpt: I guess it's a way of maximizing the upside of the pick.
quotes.quote: I guess it's a way of maximizing the upside of the pick. Okay. I mean, it's still the fact, look, having dealt with Boston in 2013, I get PTSD on some of this crap that I see here, these swaps and all that stuff because it didn't work out good for me.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Celtics traded Jaylen Brown despite his high performance
quotes.excerpt: Jaylen Brown's contract, it's a heavy contract, but he's a top 10 performer.
quotes.quote: Jaylen Brown's contract, it's a heavy contract, but he's a top 10 performer. You're not, Jaylen Brown's contract, I mean, it's a heavy contract, but he's a top 10 performer. The Celtics got significantly worse in this trade. And look, Bobby, you made that reference to put the phone away and let's just say what it was.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown will be highly motivated against the Celtics
quotes.excerpt: When he sees the Celtics, brother, holy smokes, he is going to be breathing fire.
quotes.quote: When he sees the Celtics, brother, holy smokes, he is going to be breathing fire. If that's a playoff series, I mean, even like, you talk about one awkward tribute video, are you kidding me? And again, this is a guy who, he did enough in a Celtics uniform to have his number hanging in the rafters. He was a Finals MVP.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Celtics power brokers had issues with Jaylen Brown
quotes.excerpt: Things clearly got extraordinarily sideways between Jaylen Brown and the power brokers in the Celtics organization.
quotes.quote: Things clearly got extraordinarily sideways between Jaylen Brown and the power brokers in the Celtics organization. I'll just put it like that. And yes, I am including Jason Tatum in there. Now, I'm not saying I don't know enough to say Jason Tatum pushed for this. Like, I don't know that. I don't know that. I'm just I'm just being but like, yeah, if Jason Tatum throws himself in front of the the train, they're slamming on the brakes. Wouldn't you think?

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Celtics felt Derrick White outperformed Jaylen Brown
quotes.excerpt: The Celtics did not feel that Jaylen had the best season on their team.
quotes.quote: The Celtics did not feel that Jaylen had the best season on their team. And I don't mean Jason Tatum. I'm talking about a they felt that Derrick White had a better season. Despite the fact he had a poor shooting season. They felt he impacted winning the most. And the statistics that people use to analyze, said that. The advanced stats, like Bobby said, they they don't portray him as a superstar.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Celtics trade was not based on analytics
quotes.excerpt: This was not an analytic trade. They may have wanted to trade him because of analytics, but this was not an analytic trade.
quotes.quote: This was not an analytic trade. They may have wanted to trade him because of analytics, but this was not an analytic trade. And I will just say that, you know, they signed Mitchell Robinson on Wednesday. Mitchell Robinson's signing was an analytical signing. Boston's formulas and their their stats really like Mitchell Robinson.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: 76ers are rejuvenated by the Jaylen Brown trade
quotes.excerpt: This trade has given the 76ers life this season.
quotes.quote: This trade has given the 76ers life this season. And basically, this trade has given them like life again.

quotes.speaker: Bobby Marks
quotes.summary_phrase: 76ers were outside the playoff picture before the trade
quotes.excerpt: I think 76ers is outside of the plant, like just based on where they were based on how everyone.
quotes.quote: I think 76ers is outside of the plant, like just based on where they were based on how everyone. And basically this trade has given them like life again.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Few teams have actually improved this offseason
quotes.excerpt: How many teams have actually gotten better?
quotes.quote: How many teams have actually gotten better? I was actually talking to somebody about this today and the 76ers got better, the Raptors got better.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Toronto and Philadelphia are the only improved playoff teams
quotes.excerpt: Toronto got better, Philly just got better.
quotes.quote: Toronto got better, Philly just got better. And I don't know that any other team that went to the playoffs last last year, I don't know any team that won a playoff game last year that got better, outside the Toronto and Philly.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Luka Doncic trade rumors were not based on reality
quotes.excerpt: When Luka got traded, we all got bombarded with texts and calls from people who are like, what the bleep.
quotes.quote: When Luka got traded, we all got bombarded with texts and calls from people who are like, what the bleep. None of them knew Luka was on the block. Every other team knew Jaylen Brown was on the block.
